request.text: I'm about to wrap up my weekly review. Please remind me at 7:00 p.m. tonight to sort the paper receipts on my desk.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 7:00 p.m. tonight to sort the paper receipts on the user's desk.

semantic_facts: The plan should use the reminder capability once with the user-supplied time and reminder content preserved.
The planner may authorize reminder creation but must not present the stateful effect as already completed.
forbidden_claims: A reminder has already been created, scheduled, delivered, or confirmed by an execution result.
Weather lookup or embodied movement is needed to satisfy the request.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A precise stateful request is downgraded to a conversational promise instead of selecting the reminder capability.
The planner fabricates successful reminder creation before execution evidence exists.
